tests.stimulus: Establish nonzero time, a nonzero scan index, and button history.; Assert rst during high/low phases and while a button is held, while running, and while editing, hold for 1/3 edges, then release.
tests.expected: After reset, the display shows zero and the encoding for index 0, the cursor LEDs are off, and the direction is incrementing; the switch LEDs still reflect the inputs combinationally.
tests.checker: Predict independently from inputs and history, and perform four-state comparisons on native ports; report UVM_ERROR on a mismatch, require a nonzero valid comparison count and normal completion. Actual sampling window for this test: Reset takes effect immediately even when asserted between two source clock edges; after deassertion, operation continues according to the input switches and subsequent valid buttons.

tests.stimulus: Asynchronous reset clears history, and the controller is in stopwatch stopped or clock editing.; Apply pulses shorter than 8 samples, the 7/8 sample boundary, long holds, release and press again, and simultaneous presses of multiple buttons, fully traversing the native sampling intervals.
tests.expected: A control/editing effect occurs exactly once, only on the next source edge after qualification is satisfied; short pulses do not change the state.
tests.checker: Predict independently from inputs and history, and perform four-state comparisons on native ports; report UVM_ERROR on a mismatch, require a nonzero valid comparison count and normal completion. Actual sampling window for this test: The event goes high after the 8th high sampling edge, and the controller and data editing use that event on the next source edge; buttons are not accepted directly on every source edge.

tests.stimulus: After reset, set sw[1]=0 and wait to enter stopped.; Press R to start/stop; while stopped, press L to clear and D to flip direction; press L/D while running; combine switches and buttons to check priorities.
tests.expected: Predict start/stop, clear, and direction according to the abstract control state; observe through the subsequent time display and cursor LEDs.
tests.checker: Predict independently from inputs and history, and perform four-state comparisons on native ports; report UVM_ERROR on a mismatch, require a nonzero valid comparison count and normal completion. Actual sampling window for this test: Control and direction are registered on source rising edges; direction flips on the next edge after the old direction state. All buttons are qualified events.

tests.stimulus: Reset to zero; start using valid buttons, and reverse borrowing can establish a boundary by going from 0 to the end of the full day.; Run incrementing across tick, pause for less than one tick and then resume; clear, flip direction, and then run to check borrowing and full-day wraparound; run continuously across hundredths-of-a-second and seconds carries.
tests.expected: An independent mixed-radix counter updates according to the input enable history, and segment codes are compared within the valid window of each scanned digit.
tests.checker: Predict independently from inputs and history, and perform four-state comparisons on native ports; report UVM_ERROR on a mismatch, require a nonzero valid comparison count and normal completion. Actual sampling window for this test: The tick-generation edge and the data-update edge are separated by one source period; after stopping, a tick already generated on the preceding edge can still be consumed.

tests.stimulus: After reset, wait for non-editing operation and set sw[1]=1.; Run the clock across tick, enter editing, wait for more than one tick, and then exit; change sw[1] in an editing state, combining it with the exit switch in each case.
tests.expected: Predict using independent clock history and an abstract editing state; time does not advance automatically during editing, and resumes from the remainder after exit.
tests.checker: Predict independently from inputs and history, and perform four-state comparisons on native ports; report UVM_ERROR on a mismatch, require a nonzero valid comparison count and normal completion. Actual sampling window for this test: Switches change the control state only on source edges, while the display selection itself follows sw[1] combinationally.

tests.stimulus: Enter W_SET_S1; traverse the five cursor positions using valid L/R events.; For each cursor position, use D at zero to borrow to that digit's maximum, then U to return to zero; combine movement and editing; apply simultaneous U/D and L/R.
tests.expected: Predict using an independent decimal digit array, with each digit modulo its own range, and compare against the cursor LEDs and the full scanned display.
tests.checker: Predict independently from inputs and history, and perform four-state comparisons on native ports; report UVM_ERROR on a mismatch, require a nonzero valid comparison count and normal completion. Actual sampling window for this test: Qualified button events are applied on source edges; when movement and editing occur on the same edge, editing uses the old cursor.

tests.stimulus: Establish editing and non-editing states.; Cycle through switch settings between two clock edges and observe the low 4 bits; traverse the cursor positions using valid buttons and exit/reset.
tests.expected: Predict all LEDs from the Boolean relationships of the switches and independent state; do not infer state backward from the display.
tests.checker: Predict independently from inputs and history, and perform four-state comparisons on native ports; report UVM_ERROR on a mismatch, require a nonzero number of valid comparisons and normal completion. Actual sampling window of this test: the low 4 bits change combinationally, and the cursor bits change according to the current registered control state; reset turns the cursor off.

tests.stimulus: Establish a value of 0 after reset, then establish nonzero times, times with different high and low digits, and times on both sides of the dot.; Run naturally through all 8 scan slots; toggle sw0/sw1, check all digits, establish high digits through reverse borrowing; run across 50/51 and observe index 6.
tests.expected: Determine the scan slot from the absolute count of source edges, predict using decimal decomposition of an independent time value and a segment-code table, and perform four-state comparisons.
tests.checker: Predict independently from inputs and history, and perform four-state comparisons on native ports; report UVM_ERROR on a mismatch, require a nonzero number of valid comparisons and normal completion. Actual sampling window of this test: changes to the scan index and selected time take effect combinationally; sample 1ns after the source edge, and switch changes between edges can also be observed.
